notes:
v4.6.114 — Day P/L now shows for every bot (not just Energy)

📊 Fixed: after the market closed, every bot's Day P/L read $0.00 except one. The daily change was being measured from the MOST-RECENT close — which, right after the bell, is today's close, so there was nothing to compare against. It now measures the full session (since the PREVIOUS close), the way brokers do, so each bot shows its real day's gain/loss. A guard also stops a deleted-then-re-added bot (like Energy) from showing a garbage number off its old history.

Update via the in-app banner.
